diagnostic: 同一字段验收义务发生冲突，初始状态或相同操作不能要求不同结果

symptom.conflict: Frozen candidate-contract + workflow/1:1 + requirement-013651 / workflow-input matrix require missing/blank `review` → input-required, but system-protected case expects workflow `complete` with NO input, then assert counter increment is invisible (baseline: complete commits without input).

rootCause.description: When a workflow is upgraded from no fields (e.g., 'default') to having required fields (e.g., 'review'), the new workflow-input obligation generates browser cases expecting complete WITH input. These conflict with inherited system-protection cases (from old assertions) that expect complete WITHOUT input from the previous workflow contract.
rootCause.mechanism: System-protection cases (classification='system-protection') are inherited via inheritBrowserCases. New workflow-input obligations (classification='frozen-business') generate cases with IDs that can match old cases but with different content (input requirements). The conflict detection throws instead of resolving the supersession.

fix.logic: In references.ts line 640-660, when a browser case ID conflict is detected (existing.id === c.id but hash differs), check if the new case is from workflow-input and the existing case is system-protection. If so, replace the old case with the new one (browsers[index] = c) instead of throwing. This allows workflow-input matrix to supersede old system-protection assertions when the workflow contract evolves.
fix.rationale: workflow-input obligations represent the current frozen workflow field contract and must take precedence over historical system-protection assertions that were valid under the old contract but are now obsolete.
